priorExecution.repairScope: Harness startup liveness and bounded before-cleanup diagnostics only; runtime C++/build/toolchain/protection/authentication pins unchanged.

timePolicy.partialSampling: Unknown/missing data is incomplete, not zero; at most three ps snapshots 0.25 seconds apart; fail monitor-unavailable if unresolved for a live owned group.
timePolicy.stallRequires: 20 minutes with unchanged log, CPU time, process roster, stable RSS and disk space, and no runnable owned process
